keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Pumas UNAM 0, Club América 1. Álex Zendejas (Club América) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Óscar Perea with a cross.
Goal! Pumas UNAM 1, Club América 1. César Huerta (Pumas UNAM) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Uriel Antuna with a cross.
Delay in match because of an injury Juninho (Pumas UNAM).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Kevin Álvarez (Club América) is shown the yellow card.
César Huerta (Pumas UNAM) is shown the yellow card.
Érick Sánchez (Club América) is shown the yellow card.
Robert Morales (Pumas UNAM) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Luis Malagón (Club América).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Óscar Perea (Club América).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Adalberto Carrasquilla (Pumas UNAM) is shown the yellow card.
Alan Cervantes (Club América) is shown the yellow card.
First Half ends, Pumas UNAM 1, Club América 1.
Substitution, Club América. Miguel Borja replaces Carlos Álvarez.
Pedro Vite (Pumas UNAM) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Pumas UNAM. Víctor Arteaga replaces Rodrigo López.
Substitution, Pumas UNAM. Álvaro Angulo replaces Juninho.
Keylor Navas (Pumas UNAM) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Pumas UNAM 1, Club América 2. Henry Martín (Club América) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the top right corner.
Substitution, Club América. Isaías Violante replaces Álex Zendejas.
Substitution, Club América. Derek Jiménez replaces Óscar Perea.
Goal! Pumas UNAM 2, Club América 2. Robert Morales (Pumas UNAM) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the top right corner.
Substitution, Pumas UNAM. Alan Medina replaces Uriel Antuna.
Substitution, Club América. Dagoberto Espinoza replaces Kevin Álvarez.
Substitution, Club América. Edwin Cerrillo replaces Érick Sánchez.
Pablo Bennevendo (Pumas UNAM) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Pumas UNAM. Luciano Herrera replaces Pedro Vite.
Second Half ends, Pumas UNAM 2, Club América 2.
